findings.evidence: Precedent at the general level in the same API: `isPPrimaryTorsion_resolutionX` / `isPPrimaryTorsion_homogeneousCochains` / `isPPrimaryTorsion_continuousCohomology` (CohomologicalDimension/Basic.lean:94,102,110) and `ContCohomology.nsmul_H1_eq_zero`, `nsmul_H2_eq_zero` — "`H¹(G, M)` and `H²(G, M)` are killed by whatever kills the coefficients `M`" (LowDegree.lean:55); the `Module (ZMod n)` pattern is already used generically in H2ZMod.lean:47.
findings.fix: Put `(hX : ∀ x : X.V, N • x = 0) → ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : continuousCohomology n X), N • x = 0` (with the resolution step as its lemma) in the general all-degree API, plus `Module (ZMod N) (continuousCohomology n X)` from `AddCommGroup.zmodModule`; make `cohomF2.two_nsmul` and `instModule` one-line corollaries.
findings.issue: `resolutionX_two_nsmul` and `two_nsmul` (line 98) are the exponent-2, trivialF2-only case of a statement whose proof is entirely generic: the only coefficient-specific step is the `0` case, which is exactly `∀ x : X.V, 2 • x = 0`; the successor case and all of `two_nsmul` (`homologyπ_surjective`, `iCycles_injective`, `Subtype.ext`) never mention `trivialF2` or `2`. `instModule` (line 240) is likewise the `N = 2` case.

findings.evidence: The general level is already what the underlying theorems are stated at and what their docstrings name: Cup/Assoc.lean:211-213 "For one coefficient object `X` with an associative pairing `P : TopPairing X X X` in all four places, this is associativity of the cup product of the cohomology ring `H^•(G, X)`", Cup/Unit.lean:95-97 "For a discrete `G`-ring and its multiplication this is `a ⌣ 1 = a`". In-repo pairings that would then get the graded ring: `fpPairing` (Cup/TrivialFp/Basic.lean:62) and the discrete-ring multiplication of `cup_assoc_mul` (Cup/Assoc.lean:248).
findings.fix: State the GOne/GMul/GMonoid/GRing layer as defs on a general `P : TopPairing X X X` with a unit `u` (`hinv`, `bil u x = x`, `bil x u = x`) and `bil (bil x y) z = bil x (bil y z)`, then let the `cohomF2` instances delegate; keep GCommRing (and the ZMod 2 GAlgebra) at the char-2 level.
findings.issue: `instGOne`, `instGMul`, `instGMonoid` (160) and `instGRing` (184) are hard-coded to `trivialF2` but no step uses the coefficients: the only trivialF2 inputs are the three private coefficient identities `cup_one_coeff_left`/`cup_one_coeff_right`/`cup_coeff_assoc` (109–133) and invariance of `u`; `instGRing` uses only linearity of `cup`. Only `instGCommRing` (207) needs characteristic two.

findings.evidence: `continuousCohomologyFunctor (n) : TopRep R G ⥤ TopModuleCat R` is general in `R` (Functoriality.lean:207), and the all-degree cup is used over `ZMod p` in `cupFp : cohomFp p G 1 →ₗ[ZMod p] cohomFp p G 1 →ₗ[ZMod p] cohomFp p G 2 := (fpPairing p G).cup 1 1` (Cup/TrivialFp/Basic.lean:111-113), with `trivialFp p G : TopRep (ZMod p) G`.
findings.fix: Drop the false claim and give the real reason — `trivialF2` is the object the existing mod-two corpus (Evens, Stiefel–Whitney, MuTwo) is stated over, so the graded algebra must sit on it rather than on `trivialFp 2`.
findings.issue: The module docstring justifies the ℤ-based coefficient object with "`TauCeti.trivialF2` is a representation over `ℤ`, as required by the all-degree continuous-cohomology API". That constraint does not exist, so the docstring misstates the API's generality and invites consumers to believe non-ℤ coefficients are unsupported.

summary: The 2-torsion lemma and the graded-monoid/ring packaging are both proved at the trivialF2-only level although neither proof uses the coefficients; the repo already states the corresponding facts generically (isPPrimaryTorsion_resolutionX, nsmul_H1_eq_zero, cup_assoc/cup_one_right for an arbitrary pairing). State them at that level and derive the 𝔽₂ instances.
